altText: Upright photograph of the Toitū Te Whenua Our Whakapapa exhibition panel headed 1930–1959, showing text and historical photographs.
caption: Toitū Te Whenua’s Our Whakapapa exhibition panel on 1930–1959 mapping and surveying, photographed on 16 October 2026. The historical panel dates and the photograph date are distinct.
dateDisplay: Historical panel period: 1930–1959; photograph taken: 16 October 2026
context: The 1930–1959 heading is the historical period described by the panel. Duane Wilkins photographed the exhibition panel on 16 October 2026; that is the capture date, not the date of the historical events shown. Bill Robertson is named in the panel; the existing site profile records a Surveyor-General Bill Robertson in the late-1980s topographic database programme, and no second person record has been created. The original JPEG is preserved unchanged; the full-size display and card variants apply EXIF orientation 6 without cropping.
derivativesNote: The supplied original JPEG bytes are retained unchanged under the source filename. Its EXIF Orientation 6 is applied to the full-resolution WebP and the card WebP; both keep the complete panel in frame without cropping. The original can be downloaded from this page.
